Resolutions of 1949

12 resolutions, 17% unanimous. Founding and early Cold War.

  • 67 (1949) The change of name of the Committee of Good Offices to United Nations Commission for Indonesia
  • 68 (1949) Transmission of General Assembly resolution 192 (111) to the Commission for Conventional Armaments
  • 69 (1949) Admission of Israel to membership in the United Nations
  • 70 (1949) The Trusteeship Council
  • 71 (1949) Conditions under which Liechtenstein might become a party to the Statute of the International Court of Justice
  • 72 (1949) A tribute to the Mediator and to the Acting Mediator in Palestine
  • 73 (1949) The Armistice Agreements and the Palestine question
  • 74 (1949) Transmission of resolutions on atomic energy to the General Assembly
  • 75 (1949) Travelling expenses and subsistence allowance of alternate representatives on certain Security Council commissions
  • 76 (1949) Future costs of UN military observers in Indonesia
  • 77 (1949) Transmission of the report of the Commission for Conventional Armaments to the General Assembly
  • 78 (1949) Transmission of proposals and records concerning implementation of General Assembly resolution 192 (111) on regulation and reduction of armaments to the General Assembly

Security Council Record is an independent record of every resolution, vote and veto of the United Nations Security Council since 1946. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the United Nations. For official documents, use the Security Council website and the UN Digital Library.

Built on the documentation of the Security Council, the CR-UNSC corpus (Fobbe, Gasbarri and Ridi, CC0), the UN machine-readable resolutions and the UNSC votes since 1946 database (Sciences Po Atelier de cartographie and GRAM, CC BY 4.0). Method and sources.
